Hi,

Thank you, but this screenshot only shows that the refund request was approved.

The amount has still not appeared in my card/bank account.

Could you please check with your payment provider or finance team and share the actual refund transaction reference, such as ARN / RRN / transaction ID, so I can follow up with my bank?

Please also confirm how many business days it normally takes for the amount to be credited.

Thank you.
